commands.command: $tmpExe = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('aiw-say-fd036-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.exe'); try { go build -o $tmpExe ./cmd/aiw-say; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'go build failed' }; $env:AIW_SAY_BIN = $tmpExe; python -m unittest tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox -v; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmpExe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:AIW_SAY_BIN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
commands.expected_side_effects: Unique random %TEMP% exe removed in finally, AIW_SAY_BIN environment variable cleanup, test temporary directory/process, 127.0.0.1 loopback mock server, and Go temporary compilation cache; no external API request, dependency download, or privilege escalation.

scenarios.behavior: Plugin invocation with positional text produces translation-only stdout.
Conflicting stdin/positional input or empty input exits nonzero with stderr diagnostic and empty stdout.
Missing default config uses built-in defaults and valid --config replaces base config.
Missing or invalid explicit config fails without partial stdout.
Profile is selected from user config path and missing/invalid profile fails.
Profile name rejects path separators and traversal input.
Defaults, installation config, profile, and explicit CLI values follow the specified precedence.
Invalid language/mode enums, unknown provider, or invalid timeout/model values fail.
Unicode, newlines, quotes, commands, and prompt-injection text are passed as source data with required preservation.
Missing credentials, auth failure, rate limit, timeout, and invalid response fail without sensitive-data leakage.
Transient retry is bounded and failures emit no partial translation.
Help/version and success/failure stdout, stderr, and exit codes match the CLI contract.
CLI works headlessly and profile examples can be copied without overwriting existing user files.
